description: Rishta Lentil Noodles Lebanese is a heartwarming and flavorful dish combining tender lentils with homemade pasta sheets, all simmered in a tangy tamarind broth. This traditional Middle Eastern comfort food is often garnished with crispy fried onions and fresh cilantro, offering a delightful blend of textures and tastes. It is a wholesome and satisfying meal perfect for any occasion.

instructions.title: Prepare the Lentils
instructions.text: In a large pot, combine the rinsed lentils with 6 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender but still hold their shape. Do not overcook.

instructions.title: Make the Pasta Dough
instructions.text: While lentils cook, combine flour and 1 teaspoon salt in a bowl. Gradually add 1/2 cup water, mixing until a stiff dough forms. Knead on a lightly floured surface for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes.

instructions.title: Roll and Cut Pasta
instructions.text: Divide the dough into two portions. Roll each portion very thinly on a lightly floured surface into a large rectangle. Cut the dough into small squares or diamond shapes, about 1 inch in size. Dust with a little flour to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: Sauté Onions and Garlic
instructions.text: In a separate pan, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat. Add one thinly sliced onion and fry until deeply golden brown and crispy. Remove from pan and set aside for garnish. In the same pan, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil and sauté the second sliced onion until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

instructions.title: Combine and Simmer
instructions.text: Add the sautéed onion and garlic mixture to the pot with the cooked lentils. Stir in the dissolved tamarind paste, chopped fresh cilantro, and season with salt and black pepper to taste. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.

instructions.title: Cook the Pasta
instructions.text: Carefully add the freshly cut pasta squares to the simmering lentil mixture. Cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the pasta is al dente. The pasta will absorb some liquid, thickening the stew. Adjust consistency with a little hot water if needed.

instructions.title: Serve
instructions.text: Ladle the hot Rishta Lentil Noodles into bowls. Garnish generously with the crispy fried onions and extra fresh cilantro. Serve immediately as a hearty and flavorful meal.

tips: For an extra layer of flavor, toast the flour slightly before making the pasta dough, or add a pinch of cumin to the lentils for a deeper earthy note.
If you dont have fresh tamarind, you can substitute with lemon juice for tang, adjusting to your preference. Start with 1-2 tablespoons and add more as needed.
Rishta is best served fresh, but leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 days. Reheat gently on the stovetop, adding a splash of water if it has thickened too much.
